>The Bible, which Wölflin was carrying as a shield at the time of his death, shows many marks of violence. >Wölflin remained a martyr in the cultural memory of the area. In the eighteenth-century, the blood-spattered spot in the Nürtingen palace chapel where Wölflin was killed and the page from his Bible marked with his blood were still venerated as evidence of a Protestant martyr.
